facts.label: Federal Skilled Worker Program
facts.text: At least 1 year (1,560 hours) of continuous skilled work, language results of at least CLB 7 in all four abilities, education assessed if it is from outside Canada, and 67 points or more on the selection grid. You must also show settlement funds unless you have a valid job offer.

facts.label: Canadian Experience Class
facts.text: At least 1 year (1,560 hours) of skilled work in Canada in the 3 years before you apply. Work done as a full-time student does not count.

facts.label: Requirements
facts.text: A permanent visa for invited workers. You need an occupation on the relevant skilled occupation list, a suitable skills assessment, an invitation to apply, 65 points or more on the points test, and you must be under 45 when invited. The visa costs from AUD 6,135.

facts.label: Job search Opportunity Card
facts.text: Lets you stay in Germany for up to one year to look for work. You need a recognised vocational or university qualification, German at level A1 or English at level B2, and at least 6 points in the points system (unless your qualification is fully recognised in Germany). You must show funds, for example a blocked account with €1,091 a month in 2026.

faq.a: No. Governments decide every application. We tell you honestly whether you meet the rules before you spend money on an application.

faq.q: How long does the evaluation take?
faq.a: The written evaluation report is usually ready within 1 to 2 days after we receive your details.
